question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is: **followed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"followed"** means to come after in time or order; to go or come after a person or thing proceeding ahead. (अनुसरण किया)
 
• **"followed" **is the correct word to fill in the blank as it appropriately fits the context of the sentence, indicating a sequence of actions or events.
 
 
• **Example: **The instructions were followed carefully by all the participants.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that Rex trailed behind Kasturi as she dashed across the garden.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **followed.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Obey **(पालन करना): To comply with the command, direction, or request of a person or a law.

 
 
• **Example:** Soldiers are trained to obey orders without question.
 
 
 
• **Listen **(सुनना): To give one's attention to a sound.
 
 
• **Example: **She likes to listen to classical music while studying.
 
 
 
• **Came** (आया): To move or travel towards or into a place thought of as near or familiar to the speaker.
 
 
• **Example:** He came to the party late but still enjoyed himself.
